purpose: Provide a product catalog module that maintains a normalized-SKU index for Product lookups and exposes catalog operations for listing available products and coordinating reservation/release of quantities. Also exposes a utility to normalize SKU strings.
components: ProductCatalog: in-memory catalog repository and coordinator for Product retrieval, availability listing, and reservation/release orchestration with compensation on failure.
normalize_sku: validation/normalization helper that trims and uppercases SKU strings.
internal_structure: The module centers on ProductCatalog, which builds and owns a mapping from normalized SKU to Product. Catalog methods use normalize_sku for consistent lookups, expose listing of available products, and coordinate multi-item reservation and release by invoking Product.reserve and Product.release. The normalize_sku function provides the SKU normalization used by ProductCatalog.
module_mechanism: At import and construction time, ProductCatalog normalizes provided Product SKUs to populate an internal map. Callers construct ProductCatalog and invoke reserve_items or release_items to mutate inventory via Product methods, with compensating releases on reservation errors. normalize_sku enforces SKU input quality by trimming and uppercasing values and raising ValueError when empty.
inputs: products: iterable of Product for ProductCatalog construction
items: iterable of CartItem for ProductCatalog.reserve_items
items: iterable of CartItem for ProductCatalog.release_items
value (string): SKU input to normalize for normalize_sku
outputs: List[Product] with positive stock, optionally filtered by tag and sorted by SKU from ProductCatalog.list_available
Inventory/reservation state mutations on Product via Product.reserve/Product.release
key_paths: Construction builds a normalized-SKU map of Product instances using normalize_sku
Lookup path: ProductCatalog.get normalizes SKU then retrieves Product or raises KeyError
Availability path: ProductCatalog.list_available filters positive stock (optional tag) and sorts by SKU
Reservation path: ProductCatalog.reserve_items validates items, retrieves Products, reserves quantities, and compensates by releasing prior reservations on error
Release path: ProductCatalog.release_items retrieves Products and releases specified quantities
side_effects: Mutates internal product index during ProductCatalog construction
Mutates Product inventory/reservations via Product.reserve in reserve_items
Mutates Product inventory/reservations via Product.release in release_items
errors: __init__: exceptions propagated from normalize_sku, unhashable keys, missing product.sku attribute, or non-iterable products argument
get: KeyError when normalized SKU not present
reserve_items: any exception during item.validate, get, or Product.reserve triggers compensating releases via Product.release and then re-raises
release_items: exceptions propagated from get or Product.release; AttributeError when items lack sku or qty or the retrieved object lacks release; TypeError when items is not iterable

normalize_sku: AttributeError: object has no attribute 'upper'
normalize_sku: The stripped value does not support upper()
normalize_sku: invalid when not value or not value.strip()

normalize_sku: value is truthy and does not support strip()
